_note: Actions are generated from controls and regulatory items. Algorithm: (1) take High-effort mandatory-framework controls first, (2) add deadline-driven items within 18 months, (3) fill to 5 from Medium-effort mandatory controls. See src/engine/baseline.js buildActions().

actions.name: Run a fundamental rights impact assessment (Art. 27)
actions.why: Regulatory pre-condition for deployment. Blocks first use of the system and surfaces other governance gaps. Required before first deployment to EU customers.

actions.name: Confirm conformity assessment route and complete documentation (Art. 9, 10, 13, 15, 43)
actions.why: The longest-lead-time high-risk obligation. Blocks deployment. Documentation debt is expensive to retrofit after launch.

actions.name: Implement bias testing and document methodology, thresholds and review cadence
actions.why: Addresses the highest-ranked risk (Algorithmic Bias E1). Directly required by Article 10 data governance obligations. Prerequisite for ongoing operational compliance.

actions.name: Update privacy notices and customer communications for Article 22 / Article 86
actions.why: Customer-visible. Low effort relative to compliance value. Interacts with GDPR Article 22 and AU Privacy Act automated decision requirements simultaneously.

actions.name: Schedule and deliver Article 4 AI literacy training to operating teams
actions.why: Article 4 applies from 2 February 2025. Regulatory deadline already passed — exposure exists now. Training directly supports Fork scenario practice and Article 14 human oversight obligations.
